Korčula, Croatia · est. a 500-year tradition

Hand-crafted traditional filigree jewellery

Handmade Filigree Jewellery from Seba Dizajn. Each delicate piece is woven by hand in sterling silver by the Seba family, carrying on a craft passed down through five centuries.

Our story

A craft passed down through generations

We are a small family business run by Adolf (“Doka”) and Ruth Seba — a Croatian / New Zealand couple. Adolf is the creative force behind Seba Silver, working alongside his father, Gjovalin.

The Seba family have practised the delicate art of filigree for roughly 500 years. Each piece is unique and fully handcrafted — an exclusive, treasured item made to be worn and loved.

Read our story

Visit us in Korčula

Watch filigree being made

Our little store sits on Ulica de Polo, beside the Marco Polo Tower in the old town of Korčula. Step in to see a full working table and watch us shape the jewellery by hand. Store open May – October, 10am – 8pm, Ulica de Polo, Korčula.
